result.rationale: Tarana sells fixed-wireless radios and cloud software to independent operators. I Squared invested through its growth-stage Global InfraTech Fund, not a direct-infrastructure mandate, and no Tarana-owned commercial broadband network, towers, fiber, service spectrum or subscribers were found.
